mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_user cu INNER JOIN `order` o ON cu.id = o.coupon_user_id SET cu.unused_count = cu.unused_count + 1, cu.locked_count = cu.locked_count - 1 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
UPDATE coupon_user cu INNER JOIN `order` o ON cu.id = o.coupon_user_id SET cu.used_count = cu.used_count + 1, cu.locked_count = cu.locked_count - 1 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
